summary: XCel Brands, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $2,971,157 of common stock under an existing sales agreement with Maxim Group LLC, which acts as sales agent. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. Shares are sold at prevailing market prices; Maxim receives 3% commission. No special-situation mechanics, such as tender, spin-off, or restructuring, are involved. The filing is routine capital raising, with no deal terms or strategic event to monitor.
